question_text: [Cryptography, PKI & Key Management - Q33] Why is AES in Galois/Counter Mode (AES-GCM) preferred over AES in Cipher Block Chaining (AES-CBC) for modern network encryption?

options.text: AES-GCM provides Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD), guaranteeing both confidentiality and cryptographic integrity verification without padding oracle vulnerabilities
AES-GCM only works on text files

answer_explanation: AES-GCM combines counter mode encryption with GMAC authentication tags, providing cryptographic integrity verification and immunity to padding oracle attacks.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: AES-GCM combines counter mode encryption with GMAC authentication tags, providing cryptographic integrity verification and immunity to padding oracle attacks.
